dogecoin.text:
Guess what? The Man from Mars is here — his Earth name?
Mr. Elone Musk (E for Extra!).
He tweets like a Martian, pays in Dogecoin, and builds rockets just to visit home! 
Let’s all say:
“Welcome back, Space Boss!” 
Now laugh... or he’s taking us all to Mars!
Imagine Dogecoin as a quantum coin: both worthless and valuable  until Elon tweets, and boom, its value wavefunction collapses! 😂 https://t.co/mGciEpv6p9
